title: Senior Delivery Manager
description:
Progressive Leasing is a leading provider of in-store and e-commerce lease-to-own solutions. With more than 20 years in FinTech, we’ve grown from start-up to industry leader by innovating, simplifying, and valuing people. We are a subsidiary of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with three business segments: Progressive Leasing , Purchasing Power (a leading employee purchase program for consumer products and services using payroll deduction), and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform.
We are currently hiring a   Senior Delivery Manager   to help grow our company and ensure our mission is achieved!  
This role is work from home position and can be performed remotely anywhere in the continental US or in one of our corporate locations in Utah, Arizona or Colorado
Employee Value Proposition (EVP) : PROG is dedicated to providing people with opportunity; opportunity for inclusive collaboration, opportunity for innovation, and opportunity for development.
WE ARE: Prog Tech is the driving force behind our company’s technological evolution. We are passionate problem solvers and technical experts, working together to deliver impactful solutions. We pride ourselves on craftsmanship, continuous improvement, and collaboration. Our culture encourages experimentation, learning from failures, and delivering meaningful outcomes.

You are equally at home in flow-based, service-oriented environments where work is continuous and interrupt-driven as you are in iteration-based teams. You understand that delivery discipline looks different depending on the team operating model, and you adapt your approach accordingly without losing rigor.
You treat AI tools as force multipliers for delivery work by using them to draft communications, model trade-offs, accelerate backlog synthesis, and generate operational artifacts faster than manual methods allow. You have a point of view on where AI augments delivery rigor versus where it creates false confidence, and you apply that judgment deliberately.

• Leverage AI tooling to accelerate operational work, including status synthesis, risk narrative generation, and backlog readiness summarization, while maintaining human judgment on prioritization and stakeholder framing decisions.

Influence and Stakeholder Management

• Influence engineer and product manager behavior through structure and data by driving accountability and shared clarity on delivery commitments

title: Clinical Informaticist
description:
As a clinical informaticist on the product management team, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that clinical data sourced from dozens of EHR systems and health information exchanges is accurate, standardized, and actionable. Working at the intersection of clinical knowledge and data engineering, you will collaborate with engineers, product managers, data scientists, and clinical operations teams to build and maintain Aledade 's clinical data integration platform - the foundation for population health management, quality measure reporting, and value-based care programs serving thousands of primary care practices nationwide.

The ideal candidate brings deep clinical data fluency, an investigative mindset, and the ability to translate complex clinical concepts into precise data specifications. You will be responsible for validating data quality across vendor pipelines, mapping clinical data to standardized terminologies, supporting quality measure accuracy, and serving as the clinical subject matter expert for cross-functional initiatives including AI-assisted clinical data extraction.

Primary Duties

• Identify, analyze, and resolve clinical data quality issues across Aledade 's multi-vendor EHR ecosystem. Investigate root causes of data discrepancies at the interface, configuration, and source system level. Produce structured findings with actionable recommendations for engineering and integration teams.

• Map clinical data elements to standardized code systems and validate mapping accuracy across clinical domains. Support the development and maintenance of Aledade 's terminology mapping capabilities, including rule-based and AI-assisted approaches.

• Support quality measure programs by ensuring clinical data completeness and accuracy throughout the reporting pipeline. Validate measure logic and code sets against published specifications. Identify data gaps impacting measure performance and collaborate cross-functionally to resolution..

• Serve as the clinical subject matter expert for new data sources, AI-powered extraction, and interoperability initiatives. Provide clinical context to engineering, product, and operations teams for data governance, vendor engagement, and process improvement efforts.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Nursing, Medical/Health Informatics, Bioinformatics, or a related field.

• 5+ years in clinical informatics, healthcare data analysis, or health information management

• Strong skills in querying, analyzing, and validating clinical data (experience with Databricks/Spark SQL a plus)

• Solid understanding and experience with standard Health Information Technology (HIT) vocabularies and terminologies.

• Hands-on experience with one or more ambulatory Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.

• Deep knowledge of C-CDA/CCD document structure, HL7 standards, and how clinical data is represented in structured exchange formats

• Experience with quality measure specifications (eCQM, MIPS, MCQM, HEDIS, etc) and understanding of how clinical data supports measure calculation

• Demonstrated ability to investigate complex data issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Understanding of working with Health Information Exchanges (HIE) or TEFCA data flows

• Knowledge of healthcare data governance and best practices in maintaining data integrity and security.

• Understanding of population health management and the data infrastructure that supports it.

• Certification in clinical informatics or health information management (e.g., CPHIMS, CAHIMS) is advantageous.

• Experience in applying machine learning or AI technologies within healthcare settings.

title: Tier 2 Technical Support Analyst
description:
The Tier 2 Technical Support Analyst serves as a key technical leader responsible for resolving complex, high-priority escalations and maintaining business-critical IT operations nationwide. Operating with high autonomy, this role drives technical decision-making across advanced infrastructure, network systems, telephony, and specialized clinical hardware.
By combining advanced troubleshooting expertise with continuous process improvement, chatbot workflow engineering, and Tier 1 mentorship, the Specialist ensures seamless service continuity, elevates organizational IT capabilities, and mitigates operational risk across healthcare environments.
Primary Job Duties

• Tier 2 Escalation & Remote User Support: Resolve complex, high-priority Tier 2 technical escalations and conduct advanced remote diagnostic sessions to ensure operational continuity for end users.

• Network Infrastructure & Troubleshooting: Perform complex network troubleshooting and infrastructure setup, managing Meraki firewalls, switches, access points, VPNs, VLANs, and DNS configurations.

• Hardware & Medical Device Support: Oversee specialized hardware deployments, integrations, and diagnostics, including critical clinical equipment (EKG, ECG, Spirometry) and point-of-sale systems.

• Endpoint Management & Imaging: Manage endpoint lifecycle operations via NinjaOne, directing system onboarding, offboarding, baseline imaging, and software deployment security controls.

• IT Procurement & Vendor Coordination: Coordinate IT procurement and manage external technical field contractors to ensure seamless physical and operational dispatch execution.

• Google Workspace Administration: Manage Google Workspace administration, governing directory structures, group permissions, and enterprise access security controls.

• 8x8 Telephony Administration: Administer enterprise 8x8 telephony infrastructure, executing critical modifications to call queues, access permissions, call routing, and auto-attendant scripts.

• AI Initiatives & Chatbot Support: Drive organizational AI integration by engineering, maintaining, and optimizing automated chatbot workflows (e.g., Cognigy) to streamline operational support.

• Tier 1 Support, Training & Upskilling: Provide critical overflow support while delivering technical mentorship and training to Tier 1 teams to elevate service desk capabilities and resolution efficiency.

• Operational & Go-Live Support: Provide real-time technical leadership and incident resolution during care center go-lives and cross-functional IT operations.

• Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Develop standard operating procedures, technical playbooks, and knowledge base assets to drive systematic operational improvements.

• Other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor's degree or commensurate experience preferred.

• 2+ years of work-related experience in IT desktop support, network administration, or technical operations (healthcare environment experience preferred).

• Strong technical background supporting Google Workspace, Ninja One (or equivalent RMM/imaging platforms), ConnectWise, and Salesforce.

• Hands-on administration experience with 8x8 VoIP/telephony systems (queue routing, auto-attendants, call scripts).

• Proven understanding of core IT infrastructure and networking concepts (Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI Model, Firewalls, VLANs, VPNs, and TCP/IP).

• Hands-on troubleshooting experience with standard IT hardware (workstations, printers), credit card machine hardware, and medical peripherals (EKG, ECG, Spirometry).

• Experience with Cisco Meraki hardware, dashboard configuration, and firewall troubleshooting.

• Experience creating IT procurement quote builds and coordinating equipment provisioning.

title: IT Operations Specialist (m/f/d)
description:

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters - keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Responsibilities

- Serve as the first point of contact for Level 1 tickets and ad-hoc helpdesk requests covering hardware, software, and workplace services across Statista's global workforce.

- Take ownership of incoming requests from qualification through resolution or escalation, ensuring timely updates, complete English documentation, and SLA compliance.

- Identify recurring issues and report patterns to the Workplace Manager to drive continuous improvement of IT services.

- Build and maintain self-service resources such as knowledge base articles, how-to guides, and FAQs, and identify automation opportunities for recurring tasks.

- Collaborate closely with Tech Ops and DWO team members on escalations, knowledge transfer, and documentation to ensure seamless handoffs.

- Support end-to-end IT onboarding for new colleagues and contribute to cross-team projects that improve IT services and workplace infrastructure.

Your Profile

- Completed IT training (e.g., IT specialist for system integration) or equivalent practical experience

- Initial professional experience in IT service or helpdesk environments

- Experience with identity and access management solutions (e.g., Microsoft 365 administration, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta - Statista uses Okta) and endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Intune

- Experience working with ITSM ticketing systems (Statista uses ServiceNow) and IT asset management tools (Statista uses Snipe-IT)

- Nice to have: experience with Jamf, macOS, iOS management

- Fluent English skills. German is a plus.

- Hands-on, solution-oriented mindset with a strong focus on delivering great user experiences

- Proactive communication style and service-oriented attitude

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

- Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

- Hybrid work and flex-time

- International team and social events

- Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

- Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

- Career & training opportunities

- Attractive locations and modern offices

- Mental health support with OpenUp

title: Advisor Solutions Consultant
description:
Overview
The MRO Advisory Solutions team is expanding beyond its current assessment offerings into performance improvement and analytics consulting. The Consultant role owns the analytical and project execution core of new advisory offerings: the data collection and analysis, the deliverables, the workplan, and the day-to-day partner engagement that makes each engagement land.
These offerings are new and pre-launch. That makes this a build role as much as a delivery role: the Consultant executes the pilots, instruments them against defined success criteria, brings back structured evidence about what should change, and helps convert what works into repeatable delivery assets so each offering can scale past its first few partners.
Responsibilities
1. Analysis and Deliverables · ~45%
Owns the analytical core of every engagement - the Collect and Analyze phases, and the authorship of key deliverables.

• Assemble and validate the engagement data set: this could include registry data (STS Adult Cardiac Surgery, NCDR CathPCI, TVT; NAACCR for oncology), read-only EMR review, Market Analytics, benchmark data, and partner-supplied operational and financial data

• Run the quantitative analysis each offering requires - this could include things like outcomes, length-of-stay, and adverse event variation; physician-level variation and documentation gaps; performance against public benchmarks; patient migration and leakage; competitive and market position

• Build the financial impact analysis: ROI and cost-impact modeling, revenue sizing, and growth opportunities

• Conduct the qualitative work - stakeholder interviews, surveys, and workflow review - and synthesize it against the quantitative findings

• Author draft findings, prioritized action blueprints, scorecards, and implementation or growth roadmaps in collaboration with the Advisory Lead and other team members

• Build and maintain the analytical assets each offering depends on: this could include data request templates, calculation and risk-adjustment logic, benchmark data sets, and performance trackers

2. Engagement and Project Management · ~30%
Runs the day-to-day of 16- to 24-week engagements, projects may run concurrently.

• Build and maintain project workplans, including milestones, owners, dependencies, and status

• Serve as primary day-to-day partner contact for working-level and mid-management stakeholders

• Lead client-facing meetings for their engagements - kickoffs, working check-ins, and final presentations

• Facilitate working sessions and stakeholder interviews; hold partner-side owners accountable to deadlines

• Surface delivery risk, scope creep, and stakeholder resistance to the Advisory team early enough to act on

• Coordinate internal contributors across Clinical Services, Product, and other teams as projects require

3. Offering Build and Pilot Execution · ~25%
Supports delivery of pilot offerings and helps shape what scaled offerings look like

• Support Business Development with offering-specific content and fit assessment during partner conversations

• Capture partner feedback and make recommendations on what should change in each offering to move from pilot to scaled offerings - phase length, data requirements, deliverable format, scope, etc.

• Document where an offering needs technology or data support and route as needed

• Convert what works into repeatable delivery assets: methodology documentation, deliverable and workplan templates, and enablement material for future delivery staff

title: Customer Transformation Specialist
description:
Why this role exists
We help customers get more value from Koronet by changing how they work-whether that’s buying smarter, serving their own buyers better, or cutting out friction.
Role Overview
We’re one team with one goal: delivering actual value. We share what we learn from customers, help our colleagues succeed, and focus on outcomes, not just checking boxes like 'completed call' or 'closed ticket.'
Transactions at Koronet

Transactions connects how our customers actually work with what our platform can do. We sit between customer feedback and product development, turning what we see in the field into real product improvements. We don't just 'do tasks'-we look for ways to solve problems and use what we learn to make the whole platform better for everyone.
What you will do

• Understand how customers operate: buying, selling, inventory, and operational friction.

• Guide customers to get more value by suggesting practical behavior changes.

• Lead discovery to uncover real constraints and trade-offs rather than surface-level issues.

• Give honest advice on what Koronet can do, what needs a workaround, and what isn't possible yet.

• Treat objections as valuable feedback, not personal rejection.

• Drive adoption through testing, follow-through, and clear evidence of progress.

• Share field insights with Product, Support, Marketing, and Sales to improve our product and strategy.

How you will work with other departments

• CS & Implementation: Prioritize measurable customer value over "completed tasks."

• Product & Support: Provide specific evidence, workflows, and outcomes to guide development.

• Marketing & Revenue: Use real-world feedback to improve messaging and targeting.

• Growth Systems: Use account data to prepare for smarter, more relevant conversations.

What success looks like

• Increased digital buying and selling in our ecosystem

• The team understands exactly why actions succeed or fail and applies that learning.

• Customers trust us because we’re transparent and don't oversell.

• The wider team gets clear, early feedback that makes our product and workflows better.

A few things this role isn't!

• A reactive ticket-queue owner or a replacement for implementation.

• A quota-chaser who makes promises other teams have to clean up.

• A project coordinator focused only on tracking activity.

• A silo; you are the direct link between our customers and our product team.

What do we expect from you

• Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or B2B operational transformation.

• Fluent in English (must).

• Enjoy speaking with customers and feel comfortable leading difficult conversations.

• Listen well and communicate clearly, connecting changes to real customer incentives.

• Handle objections with curiosity and use them to improve future conversations.

• Has strong organizing skills.

• Team Player, who shares information and puts company goals first.

• Experience in the floriculture industry will be considered a strong plus.

What We Offer:

• An independent, flexible, and versatile role within a fast-growing international organization.

• Flexible / Remote working environment.

• We encourage continuous learning and professional growth.

Why Join Koronet :

• Global and Remote-First: Work with a diverse team across the Americas and Europe, with flexibility to work from anywhere.

• Ownership Culture: We foster an environment where each team member takes ownership and is empowered to contribute to the company's success.

• Growth & Development: We support continuous professional growth and offer financial assistance for technical certifications and other learning opportunities.

• Compensation: Competitive salary and an indefinite contract, with salary negotiable based on experience.

If you're passionate about making an impact and growing with a dynamic, remote-first company, we want to hear from you!

title: Director - Post-Silicon Validation (Functional)
description:
Graphcore

Director-Post Silicon Validation (Functional)

Graphcore is a globally recognised leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and data centre hardware that provide the specialised processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption.  

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. We are opening a new AI Engineering Campus in Austin, Texas which will play a central role in Graphcore's work building the future of AI computing.  

We are developing the next generation of AI compute, a large-scale system-on-chip (SoC) designed to power future high-performance AI systems. 

 

Job Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to be part of a collaborative, cross-functional development team validating cutting-edge, high-performance AI chips and platforms.

You will play a key role in supporting new product introductions and validation. You will lead a team delivering post-silicon validation across the full AI SoC, working across silicon, firmware, and platform levels. The role requires a deep technical understanding, strong hands-on debug experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively with hardware, software, and systems engineering teams.

Working within the Validation team, you will be involved with bringing first silicon to life, functionally validating it and working closely with many other teams to help it become a fully   characterised   and working product, reporting project status/progress to program management on a regular basis. You will have the opportunity to provide technical guidance to other engineering team members. In this role, you can leverage our experience and industry knowledge to architect and drive implementation of continuous improvements to test infrastructure and processes.

 

The Team

The Post-Silicon   Bringup   team sits within the Architecture and Validation team, we are responsible for   bringup   and validation of new silicon when it returns from manufacture, enabling and supporting the production SW and FW teams to bring up their software and supporting the Silicon Characterisation team.

 

Responsibilities and Duties:

•   Plan, design, develop and debug silicon validation tests in bare metal C/C++ on FPGA/Emulator prior to first silicon

•   Deploy silicon validation tests on first silicon and debugging them

•   Develop automated test framework and regression test suites in Python to optimize validation efficiency

•   Collaborate closely with engineers from many other disciplines on a variety of topics

•   Work with Validation and Production Test engineering peers to implement best practices and continuous improvements to test methodologies

•   Analyse test results, identify and debug failures/defects

•   Contribute to shared test and validation infrastructure

•   Provide feedback to architects  

 

Minimum Qualifications:

•   Understanding of ML applications and their workloads

•   A self-starter who can apply independent judgement

•   A team player able to lead and support colleagues with difficult concepts

•   Strong experience in Bare metal / embedded C/C++

•   Excellent problem-solving, analytical & diagnostic skills

•   Ability to work across teams and programming languages to find root causes of critical and complex issues

•   Experience of the post-silicon validation process applied in digital ASIC environments

•   Python, Linux

•   Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain difficult concepts to resolve issues 

 

Preferred Qualifications:

•   10+   years  experience  

•   Experience building and leading, multi-site team

title: Senior HW Engineer – Signal and Power Integrity
description: The Opportunity Every board Lumai builds has to run multi-gigabit links and feed high-current ASIC and FPGA rails. Getting those right before the board is fabricated is the difference between a working system and a respin cycle. This role owns the modelling, the stackups, the materials and the design rules that make it work, and has a direct say in the decisions that prevent the respin. The Role You will own signal and power integrity across our boards and packages. That means pre-layout channel studies that set routing topologies, stackups, materials and constraints; post-layout analysis of critical channels, including insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis with IBIS-AMI models; optimisation of vias, breakouts, connector launches and the transitions into our optical engines; and PDN impedance targets, decoupling strategies and DC drop analysis for high-current rails. What is genuinely hard is that the channels cross boundaries - chip, package, interposer, board and optical engine - and a model is only as good as its weakest corner. You will spend as much time at the bench as in the tool, correlating what you predicted against what the hardware does, and feeding that back into design rules. By month six, you will have signed off the critical channels on at least one board, built the model libraries and design guidelines the team reuses, and be the person whose analysis decides when a layout is ready to release. What You'll Do Run pre-layout channel studies to set routing topologies, stackups, materials and design constraints for high-speed interfaces. Carry out post-layout SI analysis

title: FinOps Analyst
description:
Embarrassed to call yourself an accountant? Don’t worry - you’re not alone.
Accounting is stuck in the past.
So, we get stuck doing boring, monotonous work as a small cog in tedious firms, or struggling to make an impact in businesses that don’t really care.
RORA was founded to improve the career options for Accountants. We promise impact, variety and progression. We’re looking for those who crave more - more responsibility and more impact - and want to keep progressing and learning with a group of people just like them.
Sound like you? Read on...
The roleWe’re hiring for a FinOps Analyst to be embedded remotely across multiple UK startups and scaleups. You'll be involved in the day-to-day running of each partner, taking care of the accountancy fundamentals, whilst also iterating and improving processes through automation and technology.
Here's what the role looks like:

• Own finance operations : Oversee finance essentials including bookkeeping, (UK) payroll, month-end processes, VAT, and AP/AR, ensuring accuracy and compliance using Xero and other software.

• Context switching : Balance working across different startups, projects, and changing priorities with accuracy, ensuring partner expectations are managed.

• Optimise as you go : Identify and drive improvements in finance processes/controls and support with new tech implementations.

• Build strong connections : Collaborate closely with RORA 's FinOps teams across the UK and India, plus your partners, to innovate and solve challenges collaboratively.

Your experience:

• A minimum of 3 years experience in finance and accounting

• Confident running finance processes independently (you MUST have strong knowledge across AP, AR and month end as a minimum)

• Familiar with UK accounting and tax regulations including VAT and payroll etc

• Experienced in using cloud software such as Xero (strongly preferred)

• Excellent level of English (verbal and written)

Your setupYou have the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in India, whether at home or a co-working space. Your working environment should be quiet and free from distractions, plus strong and reliable internet in a must! Your working day will need to overlap with GMT standard working hours - we ask for at least 4 hours of your day to coincide with UK hours.
It’s probably not for you if…

• You crave structure and predictability - we believe in moving fast, iterating on the go and figuring things out for ourselves

• You prefer direction - startups can be unpredictable, we move and adapt with the changes (that’s the fun part!)

• You require focus on individual tasks - variety is the spice of RORA life, we effortlessly move between competing priorities.

Life at RORA We’re committed to providing variety, impact and progression, and we do it better than anywhere else.
Benefits
💰 A starting salary of 15 lakhs pa, increasing to 16 lakhs upon successful completion of probation (Mon-Fri)
⏰ Quarterly feedback and bi-annual progression reviews
💰 Annual profit share
⏱ Flexible working
🏝 Fully flexible holiday (34 days to take whenever you like)
🥂 Virtual and in-person team get-togethers
👩‍💻 Co-working space allowance
🚑 Healthcare cover (on passing probation)
💻 One-time tech allowance
🥗 Monthly lunch allowance
🔎 New to startup/scaleup life? Don’t worry - we’ve created a FinOps Training course just for you.
Meet RORA RORA builds fractional Finance teams for startups and scaleups, giving you access to some of the most exciting and innovative businesses in the world. We offer the security of being an employee, the variety of contracting, and the support and development opportunities of a big firm.

We promise transparency and fairness
This applies to both our recruitment process and the way we run the company. We're committed to fostering a diverse, healthy and supportive workplace for all. We’re an equal opportunities employer and we genuinely welcome applications from all backgrounds.

title: Principle Engineer, 3D Reconstruction
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Define the technical architecture and roadmap for Wayve’s offline 3D reconstruction system.

- Lead the development of MVPs that unblock high-priority internal use cases, while guiding the transition to a robust internal platform.

- Establish the core technical interfaces, output representations, and tools needed to support internal customers.

- Partner with calibration, sensor fusion, perception, data, infrastructure, and validation teams to align requirements, resources and ownership boundaries.

- Set technical standards for reconstruction quality, failure analysis, uncertainty measurement, and dataset suitability and execute strategies to validate them

- Mentor and provide technical leadership to engineers contributing to the 3D reconstruction effort.

- Communicate technical tradeoffs, limitations, and progress clearly to engineering leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

Leading the development of an offline 3D reconstruction capability that builds high-quality 3D world geometry from vehicle sensor data in dynamic scenes. The system will draw on localization and mapping, state estimation, and sensor fusion to produce offline 3D geometric reconstructions and best-estimate ego motion from heterogeneous vehicle platforms and sensor suites. The work will support internal validation, data enrichment, and model development by turning raw sensor data into reliable, quality-assessed 3D ground-truth outputs. This is a principal-level technical leadership role for someone who can set the technical direction, build early prototypes, and align cross-functional teams around a shared reconstruction capability.

🙌 You should apply if you have:

Required Skills/Experience

- Deep technical expertise in SLAM, 3D reconstruction, mapping, state estimation, or closely related robotics/perception fields.

- Strong hands-on experience with lidar-based reconstruction, point-cloud registration, pose estimation, and real-world robotics sensor data.

- Experience building offline reconstruction, mapping, or perception systems that operate on large volumes of sensor data.

- Strong software engineering skills in C++, Python, or similar robotics/perception environments.

- Experience taking research or prototype algorithms into reliable production systems.

- Comfortable defining technical strategy, roadmaps, and milestones in ambiguous problem spaces

- Strong cross-functional technical leadership in ambiguous, multi-team environments.

- Clear communication of algorithmic tradeoffs, limitations, confidence, and failure modes to technical and cross functional stakeholders.

- Systems-level understanding of sensor calibration, timing, synchronization and quality issues, and ability to define requirements and work with specialist teams to achieve them

Desired Skills/Experience

- MS/PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, State Estimation, Sensor Fusion, SLAM, 3D Reconstruction, or a related technical field; or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience with autonomous vehicles, robotics, mapping, or ground-truth data pipelines in a production setting.

This role requires independent work under general supervision within their disease group or CTO, with a focus on ensuring compliance and efficient trial execution.

• Day-to-Day Project Oversight: Manage the daily operations of assigned clinical trials, ensuring efficient execution and adherence to timelines while maintaining compliance with clinical trial regulations. This involves monitoring budgets, resources, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to meet project milestones.

• Trial Master File (TMF) Development and Maintenance: Develop and maintain the TMF, ensuring all essential documents are organized, accessible, and compliant with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) standards. • Protocol and Consent Form Development: Assist the Principal Investigator (PI) in developing protocols and consent forms for initial applications and amendments, ensuring they meet regulatory requirements and are easily understood by participants. This requires translating complex scientific concepts into clear, concise documents.

• Clinical Trial Phases Management: Initiate, plan, and oversee the start-up, active, and close-out phases of clinical trials, particularly for PI-initiated and multi-center studies. Prepare protocol-related reports and data summaries to support ongoing research activities and decision-making.

• Administrative Support: Schedule research team meetings and conference calls, facilitate mailings, and perform other project-related administrative tasks to ensure effective communication and coordination among team members and external collaborators

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Basic understanding of clinical trial processes and regulatory requirements, including Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.

• Familiarity with trial management software and tools

Jobbeschreibung

StackFuel ist seit Jahren einer der führenden Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung in Deutschland. Du steigst als eine der ersten Personen in unsere neue FDE-Unit ein, die wir in den nächsten Jahren deutlich ausbauen wollen, mit entsprechendem Gestaltungsspielraum und der Perspektive, früh Verantwortung für Team und Methodik zu übernehmen.

Als Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d) arbeitest du genau dort, wo dieses Ziel Wirklichkeit wird: direkt bei unseren internen und externen Kunden, an der Schnittstelle zwischen Technik und echten Geschäftsanforderungen. Du übernimmst gerne End-to-End-Ownership, verstehst, was große Unternehmen und ihre Fachbereiche brauchen, und baust daraus AI-Lösungen, die in Produktion laufen und messbar wirken.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du arbeitest direkt mit Kunden und Fachbereichen zusammen und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete technische End-to-End-Lösungen

- Du entwickelst Kundenlösungen und Produkte mit direkter Schnittstelle zu unseren internen Systemen und Plattformen.

- Du entwickelst AI-Prototypen und -Lösungen und integrierst AI End-to-End in deine Lösungen, vom Backend bis zum Frontend

- Du bringst Lösungen zuverlässig in Produktion, inklusive Deployment, Monitoring und Tests

- Du achtest darauf, dass unsere Lösungen datenschutzkonform und für den Einsatz in der EU geeignet sind

- Du befähigst unsere Kunden, deine Lösungen eigenständig zu betreiben und weiterzuentwickeln

- Du gibst Learnings aus Kundenprojekten an Produkt und Engineering zurück

Was du mitbringst

- 5+ Jahre professionelle Erfahrung in dem Bereich in der Softwareentwicklung, davon mindestens 2 in kundennahen oder Full-Stack-Rollen. Erfahrung als “Solution Engineer” oder “AI Engineer” von Vorteil.

- Du arbeitest AI-first und nutzt AI-Tools selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag. Darüber hinaus kannst du dein Wissen teilen und ins Team tragen.

- Erfahrung mit End-to End-Entwicklung mit Python (FastAPI oder Django) und TypeScript/React

- Sicherer Umgang mit PostgreSQL, Schema-Migrationen, Testing und CI (pytest, typisierter Code, GitHub o. Ä.)

- Erfahrung mit Docker-basiertem Deployment und sicher in Observability

- Erfahrung in kundennaher Delivery: Du hast bereits Anforderungen aus Fachbereichen in funktionierende Lösungen übersetzt

- Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und kommunizierst sehr gut in englischer Sprache

- Erfahrung im Bereich der DSGVO, betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis und im Solution Engineering sind ein Plus

- Reisebereitschaft um mit Kunden Lösungen zu besprechen und zu implementieren

Passt eher nicht zu dir, wenn …

Diese Rolle ist wahrscheinlich nicht das Richtige für dich, wenn du am liebsten mit klar ausformulierten Tickets arbeitest und Kundengespräche lieber anderen überlässt. Als Forward Deployed Engineer sitzt du selbst mit Fachbereichen am Tisch, stellst die richtigen Fragen und findest heraus, was eigentlich gebraucht wird.

Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur

Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation

Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Your role as Portfolio Manager is part of our Portfolio Management team. The mission of the role is to ensure that the portfolios of our UHNW clients are actively monitored, well-constructed and aligned with their objectives.
The Associate is allocated to a defined group of European client relationships, covering OCIO and portfolio advisory mandates. The role carries direct ownership of portfolio oversight, from asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk to the quality of the investments proposed to clients.
The role reports to Head of Portfolio Management, and cross-reports to the Relationship Managers. It works in close collaboration with both, providing RMs with timely, high-quality investment input and the confidence that their clients are being taken care of even when they are not looking.
Key Responsibilities

• Oversee client portfolios for OCIO and portfolio advisory clients, playing an active role in shaping clients’ portfolios across a range of asset classes (fixed income, public equity, alternative assets...)

• Identify sub-optimal products (fees, quality, overlap) and propose better alternatives

• Support Relationship Managers with timely, high-quality investment input ahead of and following client discussions

• Track transactions, changes and next steps, so that monitoring and follow-up actions are not missed

• Support business development meetings with prospective clients

• Work closely with the Portfolio Management team on portfolio construction and investment decisions, with a view to contributing to the continuous improvement of our investment process
What We Are Looking For

• Outstanding academic background with a master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or related disciplines

• Solid experience in portfolio management or advisory, ideally for UHNW individuals, within a Multi-Family Office, OCIO, Private Bank or Wealth Manager

title: Junior Sourcing Specialist
description:
About the role: What’s in the Box

You will join our European Strategic Sourcing Team, which buys the ingredients and products behind millions of HelloFresh meals across multiple markets. Our ambitious team is growing and we have several junior roles open within the Procurement team, each with its own focus.

You don’t need to pick a specific position upfront. During the process, we’ll get to know your strengths and interests and discuss together where you’d fit best. Whichever role you take, you’ll learn how international procurement works from start to finish and help make sure our customers get high-quality products at the right cost, every week.

Please note: For junior positions, we are unable to offer visa or work permit sponsorship, either now or in the future. To be considered, you must have the legal right to work in your preferred location.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Support procurement strategies and plans across our European markets, working closely with experienced colleagues in the team.

• Analyse supplier offers, cost data and market prices to build cost models and spot savings opportunities.

• Monitor market trends and supply risks, using data and Generative AI tools to support pricing forecasts and decisions.

• Identify and assess suppliers, prepare negotiations and take ownership of selected suppliers as you gain experience.

• Collaborate with product, culinary, food safety and quality, and operations teams to bring new products to our customers on time.

• Contribute to cross-functional procurement projects and keep local and global stakeholders up to date on progress.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree, for example in business, supply chain, engineering, or food science.

• Up to 2 years of experience in procurement, supply chain or a related field. Exposure to the food industry is a plus.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to build relationships with suppliers and colleagues across teams, countries and functions.

• A proactive, organised mindset. You take initiative and enjoy learning quickly in a fast-moving environment.

• Excellent English. Another European language is a plus, as is a willingness to travel occasionally within Europe.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Our benefits vary by country. Here is a taste of what you can expect:

• Tasty discounts : generous discounts on HelloFresh and our other brands, plus savings with partner brands.

• Learning & growth : internal training, and mentoring opportunities

• Flexibility : a hybrid working setup

• A warm welcome : an onboarding program and a dedicated manager

• Wellbeing : discounted fitness memberships and access to mental health and mindfulness apps.

• Financial security : a company pension scheme and commuting support, depending on your location.

• Great people : team events, Friday drinks and a lively office culture.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need-and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework - be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

• Explorer (Level 1) - Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

Sales will own commercial negotiations. You will make those negotiations more likely to succeed by building the relationships, gathering the intelligence, shaping the business case, and resolving the operating and value questions that determine retention and growth.

• Partner with Sales on cross-sell and upsell and mobilize Sword's internal specialists as resources in an account plan you still own.

title: Volunteer, Operations - China Country Team
description:
Overview
The Clinton Health Access Initiative , Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.
CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.
At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work:
CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. • Support the team with ad hoc tasks and ensure smooth operations.

title: Radar Engineer
description:
Location: Onsite - Austin, TX

Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time

Job Title: Radar Engineer

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the

tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we

aren’t just "innovating"-we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and

neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power,

counter-drone system built for the edge-on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.

Why 9 Mothers?

While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate

survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven

builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see

your code or hardware in the field next month-not next year-this is your playground.

Position Summary

9 Mothers is hiring a Radar Engineer to own the radar sensing layer of our counter-sUAS

kill chain. In this role, you will integrate and tune radars from multiple vendors so that their

detections and tracks feed cleanly into our platform-alongside our passive acoustic

(Vor) and in-house visual detection stack-giving Edda and future systems an earlier,

more reliable picture of incoming threats.

You will own the full radar lifecycle: characterizing sensors, writing the software that

ingests and processes radar data, tuning radar configurations for performance against

small, fast, low-RCS targets in cluttered environments, and validating that performance

on the range. This role sits at the intersection of RF engineering, embedded and real-time

software, and systems integration in a fast-moving defense startup environment.

Radar Engineer - Job Description (Draft)

Page 1 of 5

Essential Duties

Radar Characterization: Run bench and range characterization of the radars we field

(e.g., FMCW, pulse-Doppler, electronically scanned arrays) to verify vendor

performance claims and establish baselines for tuning.

Radar Integration: Integrate multiple radar models into our counter-drone platform,

including mechanical/electrical interfaces, timing and synchronization, coordinate-

frame alignment, and vendor SDKs, APIs, and data protocols.

Software Development: Design, build, and maintain the software that configures

radars and ingests, filters, and publishes their detections and tracks to the rest of our

system in a reliable, low-latency manner.

Performance Tuning: Tune radar parameters-waveform and mode selection,

detection thresholds, CFAR, clutter maps, Doppler filtering, and track

initiation/maintenance-to maximize probability of detection and minimize false

alarms against small, fast sUAS in real-world environments.

Sensor Fusion Support: Work with the perception and controls teams to fuse radar

tracks with acoustic and EO/IR data, and to cue our visual tracking and effectors from

radar.

Testing & Validation: Build and execute test plans, including simulation, hardware-in-

the-loop, and live-flight range testing with our UAS pilots, and establish metrics for

detection range, track quality, latency, and false-alarm rate.

Field & Customer Support: Support radar setup, site surveys, and tuning during

customer demonstrations, pilots, and field deployments, troubleshooting issues from

the RF front end through the software stack.

Documentation: Produce and maintain integration documentation, interface control

documents (ICDs), tuning guides, and test reports for internal teams and external

partners.

Requirements

Radar Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience as a radar engineer, radar systems

engineer, or similar role, including work with more than one radar type or vendor.

Integration Track Record: Demonstrated experience integrating radars into larger

systems (vehicles, fixed sites, C-UAS, air defense, autonomy, or similar)

title: Staff Software Engineer (f/m/d) Virtual Network Functions
description:
About IONOS

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.

Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

The IONOS Cloud VNF Development team is seeking a highly motivated and experienced software engineer.

The VNF Development team designs, develops and maintains the Virtual Network Functions (VNF) behind IONOS Cloud's network offerings. These products serve both our external customers and other internal IONOS teams. We build our VNFs in Golang and run them on Kubernetes, so the team works across the whole lifecycle: architecture, implementation, deployment and day-to-day operations. As part of the team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping and running these products.

We are looking for someone to join our team and work with us on providing the best VNF products possible.

Tasks

• Developing and supporting our multiple modern, scalable and high-performance Virtual Network Functions (VNF) offerings of IONOS Cloud using a range of diverse technologies.

• Designing new features and adopting new technologies (both hardware and "software defined") on different components of the VNF infrastructure.

• Writing, testing and reviewing Golang services for our VNFs, using AI-assisted tooling as part of your daily development workflow.

• Deploying, operating and troubleshooting VNF workloads on Kubernetes, including cluster operations, upgrades, monitoring and debugging network issues in production.

• Cooperating with other teams to ensure the smooth integration of new Virtual Network Functions with different IONOS products.

Qualification

• Proficiency in Golang and/or C/C++, including AI-assisted development.

• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes architecture and operations; knowledge aligned with CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) principles.

• Knowledge of the TCP/IP protocol family and networking technologies such as Open vSwitch, OpenFlow, VXLAN, VRF and eBPF.

• Experience with cloud environments and virtualization technologies like QEMU/KVM.

• Experience with the GNU toolchain (gcc, gdb, make, etc.), git and the Linux CLI.

• Experience with Linux system administration and automation.

• Nice to have: Linux kernel networking internals, VPP and DPDK.

We value diversity and welcome all applications - regardless of, for example, gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity, physical characteristics, marital status or any other irrelevant factor subject to applicable law.

• Design and run the onboarding path for newly acquired or newly connected businesses (following FreeNow, Gett, and TBR) covering platform, systems, P&L, reporting, and GTM motion

• Partner with Partnerships, Rider, and MBA to bring AI/agentic surfaces and protocol work into the Global B2B plan from the start, rather than reconciling separate efforts after the fact

description:

The Product Manager owns the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for our integrated supply chain e-commerce platform. You will be the voice of the customer and the market, prioritizing features across the customer-facing storefront, the critical internal SaaS tools (MES, WMS, OMS), and our cutting-edge AI agent capabilities. Internship Details
Duration: 3 months
Start Date: Immediate
Location: Remote
Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.
Key Responsibilities & Core Projects
You will be the central hub, defining what gets built and why , ensuring alignment with the business flow: MES → WMS → OMS → Payments.

• Product Vision & Roadmap: Own, define, and communicate the product vision and strategic roadmap for the entire ecosystem. Prioritize features and initiatives based on customer feedback, market analysis, and defined business metrics (KPIs).

• Stakeholder Coordination: Act as the primary coordinator for cross-functional teams (Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Support), ensuring clear communication, aligned goals, and timely delivery within the Monorepo structure.

• Requirements & User Research: Conduct in-depth user research, usability studies, and data analysis to deeply understand customer pain points and opportunities. Translate insights into clear, prioritized user stories and product requirements.

• Data-Driven Iteration: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for the platform. Constantly iterate on the product based on A/B test results, performance data from the Observability stack, and adoption rates.

• Go-to-Market Strategy: Collaborate with marketing and sales to define the go-to-market strategy for new product releases, ensuring successful launch and adoption.

Product Ecosystem Focus
You will directly impact the direction of these critical systems:

• E-commerce/B2B Portal: Optimizing conversion funnels (Catalog, Cart, Checkout) and developing B2B-specific features (e.g., customized pricing, bulk ordering).

• Supply Chain SaaS: Defining feature sets for the core operational modules (WMS, OMS, MES) to improve efficiency and reduce compliance risk (e.g., integrating HS code verification).

• Licensing & Tenants: Working with the Solution Architect to define feature packaging, usage metering, and the economic model for the multi-tenant JWT-based licenses.

AI Agent Focus
You will be responsible for productizing our AI capabilities, turning technology into measurable business value.

• Agent Feature Definition: Define use cases and success metrics for autonomous AI agents (built with LangChain/AutoGen) in areas like customer support, internal workflow automation, and predictive analytics.

• Productizing LLMs: Translate AI model capabilities into usable, scalable features that solve real business problems, managing the user expectations around LLM reliability and context.

Success Metrics & Career Path
Performance will be measured by:

• Business Impact: Measurable success against defined KPIs (e.g., increased conversion rate, reduced support costs via AI automation, improved internal efficiency).

• Roadmap Health: Accuracy of roadmap projections and success in launching high-impact features on time.

• Team Alignment: Feedback from engineering and design teams regarding clarity of vision and requirements.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Head of Product, serving as the primary mentor for product thinking and customer focus across the engineering and intern teams.

title: Member Intake Specialist
description:
About Eleanor Health

At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives. We work to fulfill this goal by building and growing the first addiction and mental health services provider designed to deliver a longitudinal, whole-person, value-based model of care for each community member. Our team is ambitious and committed to this unique opportunity, and understands the importance of attracting strong and experienced talent to make our vision for Eleanor Health a reality every day, and for every recovery journey we are entrusted to be a part of.

About the Role

The Member Intake Specialist plays a critical role in connecting people to life-changing addiction and mental health care at Eleanor Health . This role sits at the intersection of healthcare access, patient advocacy, and consultative sales.

Member Intake Specialists are often the first human connection a prospective member has with Eleanor Health . You will guide individuals and families through moments of uncertainty, help them understand their care options, and confidently advocate for Eleanor Health ’s care model when it is the right fit.

This is not a traditional call center or passive customer service role. Success requires urgency, empathy, follow-through, and a strong comfort with goals, metrics, and outcomes. You will work in a fast-paced, technology-enabled environment where your efforts directly impact access to care, enrollment, and recovery outcomes.

This is a part-time role working 20-29 hours per week.

What You'll Do

• Serve as the first point of contact for prospective members via inbound phone calls, web form submissions, and online scheduling workflows

• Proactively outreach to prospective members who:

•

• Start but do not complete online scheduling

• Submit web forms requesting information

• No-show to their first appointment and need re-engagement

• Confidently educate prospective members on Eleanor Health ’s whole-person care model, including what we do and what we don’t offer, while positioning Eleanor as a strong option for people seeking support with substance use

• Use a consultative, sales-oriented approach to:

•

• Understand a prospective member’s needs, motivations, and barriers

• Address concerns and hesitations

• Clearly articulate the value of Eleanor Health ’s approach to care

• Maintain ownership of leads by creating follow-up tasks, documenting next steps, and ensuring no prospective member “falls through the cracks”

• Manage inbound referrals from external providers and community partners, including proactively outreaching to confirm receipt of referrals, provide status updates when appropriate, and request additional or updated contact information to ensure timely connection to care

• Meet or exceed individual and team performance metrics, including:

•

• Answer rate & speed to answer

• Quality score

• Conversion to scheduled and completed first appointments

• Accurately document all interactions in CRM (Salesforce) and EMR (Athena)

• Collaborate closely with clinical and operations teams to ensure a seamless member experience

• Continuously improve your approach by incorporating feedback, coaching, and performance data

Qualifications

• You have experience in healthcare, ideally in patient access, care coordination, community outreach, admissions, intake, or member engagement

• You bring a sales mindset - you are persuasive, confident, and motivated by outcomes, while remaining deeply empathetic and ethical

• You are comfortable working in a metrics-driven environment and understand that data is a tool for improvement, not pressure

• You have a “fire in the belly” for expanding access to high-quality, stigma-free addiction and mental health care

• You take ownership - if someone says “I’ll call back,” you create a follow-up plan rather than closing the loop

• You move quickly, manage multiple leads at once, and thrive in a fast-paced environment

• You are tech-savvy and comfo

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cards
locationText: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
description:
As the story goes, in 1949 Frank McNamara finished dinner at a New York restaurant and found he'd left his wallet in another suit. His fix was a card that let members eat now and pay later. That card became Diners Club, widely credited as the first multipurpose charge card. It was a piece of cardboard and a promise: the restaurant trusted the card, the card trusted the member, and someone had to make sure the money actually moved.

More than seventy-five years later, the promise hasn't changed, but the machinery has. When a Mercury customer taps their card, the request goes from the merchant's terminal through an acquirer and a card network to us. In a fraction of a second, we check the balance, apply the customer's spend controls, screen for fraud and say yes or no. After that comes clearing, settlement, disputes and reporting, and every cent has to reconcile.

Cards are the way Mercury customers spend money. The Cards Integration team owns the whole Mercury card, not just the swipe: issuance, physical card shipping, spend controls, lifecycle management, authorization, money movement, settlement and reporting, and the infrastructure underneath. We're a full-stack team, and our job is to make the Mercury Debit and IO cards reliable, correct, useful, and innovative.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thinks deeply about systems architecture, cares about the customer experience, and will dive into any problem to move the team forward. We value high ownership, working in pairs and teams rather than alone, and attention to detail. Those matter when you run systems held to four nines of reliability, and everyone around you will care about them too.

In this role, you will

• Lead projects from idea to tech spec to implementation to launch, working with your PM, EM, tech lead, and teammates at each stage. When you lead a project, it's yours to see through.

• Learn how debit and credit cards actually work under the hood (authorization, clearing, settlement, disputes) and use that knowledge every day.

• Build features across the stack, from the card experiences customers use to the backend systems that move money.

• Help keep our operations excellent. Our systems are some of the most observable at Mercury, and with great observability comes great responsibility.

• Mentor other engineers and raise engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and collaboration.

• Work with product, design, operations, risk, compliance, sales, and many other teams.

You should

• Have strong full-stack experience, a product mindset, systems thinking, and a knack for getting things across the line.

• Have made architectural decisions on complex systems, and be able to explain your reasoning and the trade-offs.

• Be excited to put new features in customers' hands, and care just as much about keeping existing ones working like a charm.

• Care about correctness in systems where failure has real financial consequences.

• Communicate clearly, handle ambiguity well, and enjoy mentoring others.

• Be comfortable with our tech stack (Haskell and TypeScript) or be ready to learn.

• Bonus: experience in fintech, payments, or card issuing.

We encourage you to try our demo site if you're interested in applying for the role.

• Partner with Product and Engineering leads to identify, plan, and prioritize projects based on team goals and resources, acting as the voice of the merchant to influence the roadmap.

このミッションを実現するためには、社員一人ひとりが目的意識を持ち、患者さんの人生に具体的な変化を生み出せる環境が必要です。私たちは、多様なバックグラウンドやスキルを生かし、自分らしく働きながら、世界中の患者さんのために力を発揮できる文化づくりに取り組んでいます。

インクルーシブな文化は、私たちのすべての活動の中心にあります。Diverse Ability、Family、Gender、LGBTQ+、Mental Health、Race/Ethnicityの6つのEmployee Network Groupを通じて、社員が自分らしく働ける環境を支援しています。これらのグループは、定期的なミーティングや活動を通じて、多様性、公平性、インクルージョンを促進し、つながり、学び、交流する機会を提供しています。また、私たちはFertility Friendly認定企業として、不妊治療に関する方針、充実した育児休暇制度、柔軟な働き方を通じて、家族形成のあらゆる段階にある社員を支援しています。
日々のキャリア経験、数千に及ぶオンデマンド研修、定期的なキャリア対話、グローバルかつ部門横断的なキャリア機会を通じて、社員の継続的な成長を積極的に支援しています。

会議の準備や議事録、進捗・アクション管理、ブリーフ作成の支援、承認状況の確認など、案件運営の土台となる業務を担当します。細かな点まで丁寧に確認し、リスクや課題を早めに共有しながら、自分の担当業務を着実に前へ進めることが求められます。
入社後は、クライアント業務を通じて、アカウントマネジメントの基礎を実践的に身につけていただきます。周囲の支援を受けながら担当範囲を広げ、将来的にはクライアントとのやり取りや、より複雑な案件進行にも関わっていただくことを期待しています。

福利厚生・働き方
Avalere Health Japanでは、柔軟な働き方と、社員一人ひとりが能力を発揮できる職場環境を大切にしています。
休暇・福利厚生制度については、日本法人の雇用条件および社内規程に基づいて提供します。
また、グローバルネットワークとの協働、継続的な学習機会、専門性を高めるためのサポートを通じて、社員の成長とキャリア開発を支援します。

description:
Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates design, engineering and AI to drive digital innovation. We are over 10,000 people strong across 47 offices in 18 countries. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology and culture as the differentiator.

Thoughtworks.com is one of our most important customer-facing products, helping clients discover our expertise, explore evidence of our impact and take the next step with us. It also helps job seekers explore opportunities and gives search engines and AI assistants an accurate, trusted understanding of who we are and what we do.

Today, fragmented ownership across Marketing limits our ability to deliver connected customer journeys, maintain consistent quality and continuously improve performance.

We’re looking for a Head of Product Design to change that. You’ll lead Thoughtworks.com as a digital product, translating our go-to-market and employer brand strategies into seamless experiences for customers, job seekers and AI agents. You’ll own the website strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, publishing model and content and design quality. You'll also shape experiences across connected channels, including email through Knak and events through Splash, while influencing the internal workflows that drive quality, consistency and speed.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role for someone who can think strategically and deliver at every level, from defining roadmaps and improving customer journeys to refining copy, reviewing designs, interpreting performance data and making launch decisions.

At Netflix , our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and are building an in-house world-class ad tech ecosystem to offer our members more choices in consuming their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.
Our Team
The Ads Engineering team at Netflix is dedicated to creating a world-class advertising ecosystem that drives our advertising business. This team's mission is to develop advanced technology that ensures exceptional experiences for both our members and advertisers. Our responsibilities encompass a broad spectrum of products, ranging from sales and media planning to optimizing advertiser outcomes and execution. This includes inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience and identity management, measurement, reporting, and finance.
We use several Netflix investments and innovations - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding, and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving so that members only see the most appropriate ads for them.
Our team is faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate us and become a market leader in record time. Our roles come with expectations of delivering in a rapid clip, comfort with lofty goals and big ambitions, the visibility that comes with strategic initiatives, and responsibility and an appetite to operate like a startup within an established company.
We are looking for engineers to join us on this journey, to be a part of some exciting initiatives, and the talented teams who work on realizing our ambitious vision.

• Well grounded domain experience in any of the following areas: Ad Serving, Ads Identity & Audiences, Ads Creatives, Inventory & Forecasting, Campaign Management, Media Planning, Measurement, Reporting, or Ads Finance.

• General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape.

• Worked closely with ad operations to enable campaign setup, targeting, reporting and advertiser needs.

• Developed many cloud based applications and comfortable with modern programming languages (preferably object oriented),

• Familiar with A/B testing and experimentation.

• Have solid experience in setting technical directions for engineering projects, making architectural decisions, and influencing partner and cross-functional teams.

Nice to haves:

• Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

• Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.

• Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of it’s unique constraints

title: NSW History Curriculum Advisor
description:
Education Perfect is an EdTech platform designed to empower educators and amplify their impact in the classroom. We help teachers personalise learning at scale through powerful learning, assessment and insights tools, supporting teachers and students to reach their full potential.
We’re looking for an experienced NSW History Curriculum Advisor to support the development of our online History offering for Stages 4 and 5. In this contract-based role, you’ll review our curriculum alignment and learning pathways, providing expert recommendations to ensure our content is accurate, relevant and aligned with the NSW History curriculum.
This is an opportunity to contribute your curriculum expertise to an education platform used by teachers and students, helping shape high-quality digital learning resources that support effective classroom teaching.
This opportunity might suit you if you:

• Have a strong understanding of the NSW History curriculum across Stages 4 and 5.

• Have experience reviewing curriculum alignment, learning pathways or educational resources.

• Can identify gaps, prioritise improvements and make practical recommendations to strengthen curriculum coverage.

• Are passionate about supporting teachers and improving student learning through high-quality digital resources.

• Have experience with Education Perfect or other EdTech platforms (an advantage, but not essential).

Project details
The project will commence in early November and continue until mid-December 2026. We anticipate approximately 20 hours of work, with a total contract payment of $2,000 AUD.
The work will involve:

• Curriculum alignment review: Review our History curriculum alignment across Stages 4 and 5 and recommend any changes needed (approximately 8 hours).

• Learning pathway review: Review the existing learning pathways and recommend improvements (approximately 8 hours).

• Prioritisation of fixes and gaps: Prepare for and participate in a collaborative session to prioritise identified gaps and improvements (approximately 2 hours).

The remaining time will allow for project preparation, collaboration and follow-up as needed.
If you’re passionate about History education and would love to help shape high-quality digital learning experiences for NSW teachers and students, we’d love to hear from you!
Please apply online with your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant curriculum expertise and experience.

Florida - Remote WHY JOIN FCS
At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.
Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.
A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS
Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.
Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.
Come join us today!

• Full-time, Monday - Friday Work Week, Days (Example: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM),

• Works with patients and families throughout the course of their treatment and beyond to provide an understanding of their disease and their nutrition plan.

• Travel : Yes
